title: Skills, extracted (large-datasets)
description: Candidate terms extracted from every skill's front matter: `name` as the label, `description` as the definition. Generated by folio-assistant-core/scripts/glossary-extract.ts; not curated, and never hand-edited: a person promotes a term by authoring it in a glossary of their own.

terms.definition: Materialized content is read-only. To work on it you take a copy into your own folio/, and the copy records what it is a copy of — the local-provenance edge, which is not the upstream one.

After bootstrap, a person asks for part of a remote subgraph to be held locally. Check what is already here (cache:index), put a number on the ask before anything is fetched, then run materialize-remote. Eviction is a report, never an act.
Landing remote content locally — the five gates, the three states, and the two purposes. One process, shared by catalogue import and harness bootstrap, plus the refresh that is not a re-import.
